title: The other musicians and their origins
summary: The band members, such as banjoist Big Boy from Ohio, came from all over, none from New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Do you remember any of the other guys in the band, the names of them?

Well, we had a guy... These guys never did amount to anything. One of the guys that played a guitar and a banjo... This guy played banjo and guitar. His name was Big Boy. He came from some place in Ohio.
So they weren't just musicians from New Orleans, Baton Rouge and there. There were musicians from all over.
In fact, they didn't have no musicians from New Orleans in this band.
Because Doc Moon picked up musicians from all over.
Oh, he traveled all across the nation, then.
